resolvedFindings.title: Refresh Care option prices when the selected service changes
resolvedFindings.reproduction: Open a general contact form prefilled for Local Search Focus, then change the package to Website Improvement Partnership. Before the fix, the Care option retained $299 while the request summary correctly showed $399.
resolvedFindings.resolution: The existing service-change refresh now derives each option label from inquiryOffer(service, context.care_variant). Verified the updated loop and exact Local Focus 199/299/445, Improvement 299/399/545 and Search 499/599/745 derived prices.

verified.result: Approved source hash matches. All 15 plan prices, four page caps (10/15/20/25), exclusions, inputs, acceptance, support windows and delivery targets match approved V4. Dynamic guide/output templates preserve the approved counts; their wording changes are semantically equivalent.

All eleven monthly variant fees resolve correctly. Production-only excludes maintenance/incident response/Care edits; selected local plans retain one location/service-area and 30 marketing-page limits. Care variants retain 60-minute edits, three ordinary inquiry journeys, and Commerce 100 products/one checkout. Brochure-only lines are removed from Commerce quoted deliverables.

Pure calculation reproductions: Local Focus Brochure with $20 hosting yields $279 W&M + $20 host = $299; $50 hosting yields $274 + $50 = $324. Commerce and production-only deduct zero. Unknown eligible hosting remains pending; no automatic assumption of free vendor costs.

Quoted snapshot retains onboarding terms, first-cycle native measurement setup, three-cycle fee protection and at least 30-day notice before later changes. Waiver eligibility remains explicit. Onboarding estimate choices are provisional before written scope credits; no production-only Care onboarding charge is accepted.

In-memory draftScope calls select the correct mutually exclusive route: both $1495; simple 10–15 business days/five distinct native automations and five tests each; complex 5–10 business days/one trigger, five actions, two branches, fifteen fields and its own acceptance tests.

Validator preserves workflow_variant=complex and rejects care_variant=production for standalone Website Care. Native prefill uses the shared allowlist; request/receipt summaries derive the selected variant. Browser code refreshes service-dependent visibility and labels.

A draft from the saved pre-V3 catalog was populated with synthetic acceptance data in memory. prepareInvoice retained the historical $1400 fixed price and $700 first milestone after normalizing a modified current catalog with a $9999 entry price; the invoice identifier was unchanged. Invoice preparation reads the saved snapshot; create-job uses exclusive file creation rather than overwriting an existing agreement.

Public offer projection excludes planning hours, stress models and other internal economics. Browser bundle inputs explicitly use that projection. Reviewed customer v3 scope fields contain no V3/review/pilot-economics leakage.

validationLimits: Read-only implementation review plus focused in-memory function invocations; no implementation/test edits, full suite, build, deployment, real client records, invoices or external messages.
Primary owns final UI/browser validation and the full test/build gates.
Review binds to the listed file hashes; later changes require reconciliation.
conclusion: No unresolved actionable commercial implementation discrepancy in the reviewed scope.
